input.context: PR: Expand PowerShell env-var detection regex to also catch lowercase variables and simplify warning logic. Language: JavaScript (MJS hook). File: hooks/preflight-shell.mjs

expected_output.rationale: The updated regex matches ALL PowerShell identifiers including built-in automatic variables: $_, $HOME, $LASTEXITCODE, $NULL, $TRUE, $FALSE, $PSVersionTable, $PSScriptRoot, $PROFILE, $ERROR, $HOST. The `env:` prefix exclusion was also removed. This means every PowerShell pipeline command using `$_` (ForEach-Object, Where-Object), every null check using `$NULL`, and every success check on `$LASTEXITCODE` will trigger a spurious warning. The hook will produce false positives on virtually all real PowerShell code, destroying signal quality. Restore the exclusion list for known PS automatic variables (at minimum: $_, $HOME, $NULL, $TRUE, $FALSE, $LASTEXITCODE, $ERROR, $PROFILE) before expanding the regex.
